Glance 2026.07.25.1 is a hotfix release for preview opening and Markdown rendering.

## Hotfix

- Prevent black title and status bars from flashing when the preview window opens.
- Prevent stale WebView2 content from flashing while reopening or switching Markdown previews.
- Reduce Markdown preview latency and improve README rendering with GitHub-style layout, relative images, and embedded HTML.
